items.source: Once in effect, the auto-configuration is the equivalent of enabling JDBC repositories using the @EnableJdbcRepositories annotation and providing an AbstractJdbcConfiguration subclass.
items.translation: 一旦生效，自动配置等同于使用 @EnableJdbcRepositories` 注解启用 JDBC 仓库并提供一个 AbstractJdbcConfiguration` 子类。

items.source: Andy Wilkinson, Stephane Nicoll, Mark Paluch, Jens Schauder
